<script>
(() => {
  'use strict';

  const canvas = document.getElementById('scene');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d', { alpha: false });

  // Respect prefers-reduced-motion dynamically
  const reducedMotionQuery = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
  let reducedMotion = reducedMotionQuery.matches;
  reducedMotionQuery.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
    reducedMotion = e.matches;
    if (reducedMotion) {
      renderFrame(0, 0);
    }
  });

  // Deterministic PRNG for organic procedural textures & placements
  function mulberry32(seed) {
    return function () {
      let t = (seed += 0x6d2b79f5);
      t = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), t | 1);
      t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), t | 61);
      return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
    };
  }

  // Smooth value noise for organic broth shimmer & steam curl
  function hash2(x, y) {
    const n = Math.sin(x * 127.1 + y * 311.7) * 43758.5453123;
    return n - Math.floor(n);
  }
  function noise2(x, y) {
    const ix = Math.floor(x), iy = Math.floor(y);
    const fx = x - ix, fy = y - iy;
    const ux = fx * fx * (3 - 2 * fx);
    const uy = fy * fy * (3 - 2 * fy);
    const a = hash2(ix, iy);
    const b = hash2(ix + 1, iy);
    const c = hash2(ix, iy + 1);
    const d = hash2(ix + 1, iy + 1);
    return a + (b - a) * ux + (c - a) * uy + (a - b - c + d) * ux * uy;
  }

  // Offscreen cached textures for rich wood grain, stoneware ceramic speckles, and nori grain
  let woodCanvas = null;
  let grainPattern = null;
  let ceramicSpeckleCanvas = null;
  let noriCanvas = null;

  function buildProceduralTextures() {
    // 1. Dark charred cedar (shou sugi ban) table texture
    woodCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    woodCanvas.width = 512;
    woodCanvas.height = 512;
    const wctx = woodCanvas.getContext('2d');
    const wrng = mulberry32(4109);

    const wgrad = wctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, 512);
    wgrad.addColorStop(0, '#130d0a');
    wgrad.addColorStop(0.5, '#19110d');
    wgrad.addColorStop(1, '#0e0907');
    wctx.fillStyle = wgrad;
    wctx.fillRect(0, 0, 512, 512);

    // Subtle horizontal wood planks & fibers
    for (let y = 0; y < 512; y += 2) {
      const wave = Math.sin(y * 0.045) * 0.5 + Math.sin(y * 0.13 + 1.4) * 0.35;
      const alpha = 0.025 + Math.abs(wave) * 0.04;
      wctx.fillStyle = wave > 0
        ? `rgba(82, 50, 30, ${alpha.toFixed(3)})`
        : `rgba(5, 3, 2, ${(alpha * 1.4).toFixed(3)})`;
      wctx.fillRect(0, y, 512, 1.5);
    }

    // Fine directional wood grain strokes
    for (let i = 0; i < 420; i++) {
      const y = wrng() * 512;
      const x = wrng() * 512;
      const len = 45 + wrng() * 190;
      const thickness = 0.5 + wrng() * 1.4;
      wctx.strokeStyle = wrng() > 0.45
        ? `rgba(68, 42, 26, ${(0.03 + wrng() * 0.05).toFixed(3)})`
        : `rgba(4, 2, 1, ${(0.06 + wrng() * 0.09).toFixed(3)})`;
      wctx.lineWidth = thickness;
      wctx.beginPath();
      wctx.moveTo(x, y);
      wctx.bezierCurveTo(
        x + len * 0.33, y + (wrng() - 0.5) * 4,
        x + len * 0.66, y + (wrng() - 0.5) * 4,
        x + len, y + (wrng() - 0.5) * 2
      );
      wctx.stroke();
    }

    // Subtle plank seam
    wctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(2, 1, 1, 0.45)';
    wctx.lineWidth = 2;
    wctx.beginPath();
    wctx.moveTo(0, 295);
    wctx.lineTo(512, 297);
    wctx.stroke();

    // 2. Ceramic stoneware iron-fleck glaze texture
    ceramicSpeckleCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    ceramicSpeckleCanvas.width = 256;
    ceramicSpeckleCanvas.height = 256;
    const cctx = ceramicSpeckleCanvas.getContext('2d');
    const crng = mulberry32(9901);

    // Subtle wheel-thrown concentric glaze variation
    for (let i = 0; i < 1100; i++) {
      const x = crng() * 256;
      const y = crng() * 256;
      const r = 0.4 + crng() * 1.4;
      const pick = crng();
      if (pick < 0.55) {
        cctx.fillStyle = `rgba(190, 155, 118, ${(0.03 + crng() * 0.07).toFixed(3)})`;
      } else if (pick < 0.85) {
        cctx.fillStyle = `rgba(12, 9, 8, ${(0.12 + crng() * 0.18).toFixed(3)})`;
      } else {
        cctx.fillStyle = `rgba(130, 88, 52, ${(0.06 + crng() * 0.09).toFixed(3)})`;
      }
      cctx.beginPath();
      cctx.arc(x, y, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      cctx.fill();
    }

    // 3. Toasted Nori seaweed texture
    noriCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    noriCanvas.width = 128;
    noriCanvas.height = 128;
    const nctx = noriCanvas.getContext('2d');
    const nrng = mulberry32(7712);
    nctx.fillStyle = '#0c160d';
    nctx.fillRect(0, 0, 128, 128);
    for (let i = 0; i < 650; i++) {
      const x = nrng() * 128;
      const y = nrng() * 128;
      const w = 1 + nrng() * 6;
      const h = 0.6 + nrng() * 1.6;
      const g = Math.floor(20 + nrng() * 28);
      nctx.fillStyle = `rgba(${Math.floor(g * 0.55)}, ${g + 8}, ${Math.floor(g * 0.45)}, ${(0.18 + nrng() * 0.25).toFixed(3)})`;
      nctx.save();
      nctx.translate(x, y);
      nctx.rotate((nrng() - 0.5) * 1.4);
      nctx.fillRect(-w / 2, -h / 2, w, h);
      nctx.restore();
    }

    // 4. Subtle film grain overlay pattern
    const gCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    gCanvas.width = 160;
    gCanvas.height = 160;
    const gctx = gCanvas.getContext('2d');
    const imgData = gctx.createImageData(160, 160);
    const grng = mulberry32(2026);
    for (let i = 0; i < imgData.data.length; i += 4) {
      const v = Math.floor(grng() * 255);
      imgData.data[i] = v;
      imgData.data[i + 1] = v;
      imgData.data[i + 2] = v;
      imgData.data[i + 3] = 10;
    }
    gctx.putImageData(imgData, 0, 0);
    grainPattern = ctx.createPattern(gCanvas, 'repeat');
  }

  // Layout metrics
  let width = 1280;
  let height = 800;
  let dpr = 1;
  let cx = 640;
  let cy = 440;
  let bowlR = 230;
  let tiltY = 0.72; // Perspective foreshortening (~44° elevated hero angle)

  function resize() {
    dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
    width = window.innerWidth;
    height = window.innerHeight;
    canvas.width = Math.round(width * dpr);
    canvas.height = Math.round(height * dpr);
    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);

    const minDim = Math.min(width, height);
    const isPortrait = height > width * 1.08;
    bowlR = Math.max(105, Math.min(minDim * (isPortrait ? 0.36 : 0.32), 270));
    cx = width * 0.5;
    cy = height * (isPortrait ? 0.56 : 0.55);

    if (reducedMotion) {
      renderFrame(0, 0);
    }
  }

  // Interactive pointer state
  const pointer = {
    x: 0.5,
    y: 0.45,
    nx: 0,      // normalized -1..1
    ny: 0,
    tx: 0,      // smoothed normalized -1..1
    ty: 0,
    vx: 0,      // velocity in screen px/sec
    vy: 0,
    lastPx: 0,
    lastPy: 0,
    px: 0,
    py: 0,
    active: false,
    overBowl: false,
    overSteam: false,
  };

  // Interactive broth ripples triggered by cursor or clicks
  const ripples = [];
  let lastRippleTime = 0;

  function addRipple(bx, by, strength = 1) {
    if (reducedMotion) return;
    // Normalize relative to broth ellipse
    const dist = Math.hypot(bx, by / tiltY);
    if (dist > bowlR * 0.88) return;
    ripples.push({
      x: bx,
      y: by,
      r: 4,
      maxR: bowlR * (0.32 + strength * 0.32),
      alpha: 0.42 * strength,
      speed: 55 + strength * 35,
    });
    if (ripples.length > 10) ripples.shift();
  }

  function updatePointerPos(clientX, clientY, isClick = false) {
    const dx = clientX - pointer.px;
    const dy = clientY - pointer.py;
    pointer.lastPx = pointer.px;
    pointer.lastPy = pointer.py;
    pointer.px = clientX;
    pointer.py = clientY;
    pointer.vx = pointer.vx * 0.65 + dx * 18;
    pointer.vy = pointer.vy * 0.65 + dy * 18;
    pointer.nx = (clientX / width - 0.5) * 2;
    pointer.ny = (clientY / height - 0.5) * 2;
    pointer.active = true;

    const relX = clientX - cx;
    const relY = clientY - cy;
    const bowlDist = Math.hypot(relX / (bowlR * 0.9), relY / (bowlR * 0.9 * tiltY));
    pointer.overBowl = bowlDist < 1.0;
    pointer.overSteam = Math.abs(relX) < bowlR * 1.15 && relY < bowlR * 0.25 && relY > -bowlR * 2.1;

    const now = performance.now();
    if (isClick && bowlDist < 0.95) {
      addRipple(relX, relY, 1.35);
      // Stir nearby steam
      for (const s of steamWisps) {
        const sx = cx + s.x * bowlR;
        const sy = cy + s.y * bowlR;
        const d = Math.hypot(sx - clientX, sy - clientY);
        if (d < bowlR * 0.9) {
          const push = (1 - d / (bowlR * 0.9)) * 1.2;
          s.vx += ((sx - clientX) / (d + 20)) * push * 0.8;
          s.vy -= push * 0.35;
        }
      }
    } else if (pointer.overBowl && Math.hypot(dx, dy) > 3.5 && now - lastRippleTime > 170) {
      addRipple(relX, relY, 0.72);
      lastRippleTime = now;
    }
  }

  window.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => {
    updatePointerPos(e.clientX, e.clientY, false);
  }, { passive: true });

  window.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
    updatePointerPos(e.clientX, e.clientY, true);
  }, { passive: true });

  window.addEventListener('pointerleave', () => {
    pointer.active = false;
    pointer.overBowl = false;
    pointer.overSteam = false;
  });

  // Procedural ingredients data (normalized to bowlR so everything scales seamlessly)
  const rng = mulberry32(20261118);

  // Oil droplets (chili oil / rayu & sesame oil floating on golden miso broth)
  const oilDroplets = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
    const angle = rng() * Math.PI * 2;
    const rad = Math.sqrt(rng()) * 0.84;
    const isChili = rng() < 0.48;
    oilDroplets.push({
      x: Math.cos(angle) * rad,
      y: Math.sin(angle) * rad * tiltY,
      r: (isChili ? 0.014 : 0.011) + Math.pow(rng(), 2.2) * 0.036,
      isChili,
      phase: rng() * Math.PI * 2,
      speed: 0.4 + rng() * 0.7,
      driftR: 0.004 + rng() * 0.008,
    });
  }

  // Toasted sesame seeds (white & black) scattered over broth & toppings
  const sesameSeeds = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 58; i++) {
    const angle = rng() * Math.PI * 2;
    const rad = 0.06 + Math.sqrt(rng()) * 0.76;
    sesameSeeds.push({
      x: Math.cos(angle) * rad,
      y: Math.sin(angle) * rad * tiltY,
      rot: rng() * Math.PI * 2,
      isBlack: rng() < 0.32,
      size: 0.0085 + rng() * 0.005,
      phase: rng() * Math.PI * 2,
    });
  }

  // Scallion rings floating naturally across the center-front and edges
  const scallions = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 24; i++) {
    const cluster = i < 15;
    const a = cluster ? (rng() * Math.PI * 2) : (rng() * Math.PI * 2);
    const r = cluster ? (0.04 + rng() * 0.28) : (0.35 + rng() * 0.42);
    const ox = cluster ? 0.06 : 0;
    const oy = cluster ? 0.05 : 0;
    scallions.push({
      x: ox + Math.cos(a) * r,
      y: (oy + Math.sin(a) * r) * tiltY,
      r: 0.034 + rng() * 0.022,
      tilt: (rng() - 0.5) * 0.55,
      rot: rng() * Math.PI,
      phase: rng() * Math.PI * 2,
      bobAmp: 0.004 + rng() * 0.004,
      bright: 0.8 + rng() * 0.35,
    });
  }

  // Sweet golden corn kernels clustered on the lower-left
  const cornKernels = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 34; i++) {
    const a = rng() * Math.PI * 2;
    const r = Math.sqrt(rng()) * 0.24;
    cornKernels.push({
      x: -0.34 + Math.cos(a) * r * 1.05,
      y: (0.28 + Math.sin(a) * r * 0.75) * tiltY,
      rot: rng() * Math.PI * 2,
      s: 0.028 + rng() * 0.011,
      hueShift: (rng() - 0.5) * 14,
      phase: rng() * Math.PI * 2,
    });
  }

  // Noodle strands (layered wavy alkaline ramen noodles coiled softly beneath & peeking through)
  const noodleStrands = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 34; i++) {
    const layer = i < 16 ? 0 : 1; // 0 = submerged, 1 = surface crests
    const baseAngle = -2.4 + (i / 34) * 5.2 + (rng() - 0.5) * 0.4;
    const arcSpan = 0.8 + rng() * 1.3;
    const rad = 0.14 + rng() * 0.58;
    const waveFreq = 5 + rng() * 5;
    const waveAmp = 0.018 + rng() * 0.024;
    const offsetX = (rng() - 0.5) * 0.26;
    const offsetY = (rng() - 0.5) * 0.22;
    noodleStrands.push({
      layer,
      baseAngle,
      arcSpan,
      rad,
      waveFreq,
      waveAmp,
      offsetX,
      offsetY,
      thickness: 0.015 + rng() * 0.007,
      phase: rng() * Math.PI * 2,
      shade: 0.85 + rng() * 0.3,
    });
  }

  // Ambient floating warm dust motes / ember-lit kitchen air specks
  const motes = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 38; i++) {
    motes.push({
      x: rng(),
      y: rng(),
      r: 0.8 + rng() * 2.1,
      vx: (rng() - 0.5) * 0.008,
      vy: -0.004 - rng() * 0.012,
      alpha: 0.08 + rng() * 0.24,
      phase: rng() * Math.PI * 2,
      warmth: rng(),
    });
  }

  // Organic multi-ribbon & volumetric steam system
  const steamWisps = [];
  const STEAM_COUNT = 54;
  function spawnSteamWisp(w, randomAge = false) {
    const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    const dist = Math.sqrt(Math.random()) * 0.58;
    w.x = Math.cos(angle) * dist;
    w.y = Math.sin(angle) * dist * tiltY - 0.04;
    w.vx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.06;
    w.vy = -(0.24 + Math.random() * 0.22);
    w.age = randomAge ? Math.random() * 4.5 : 0;
    w.life = 3.2 + Math.random() * 2.8;
    w.size = 0.14 + Math.random() * 0.22;
    w.curlFreq = 1.1 + Math.random() * 1.4;
    w.curlAmp = 0.09 + Math.random() * 0.16;
    w.phase = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    w.opacity = 0.065 + Math.random() * 0.075;
    w.stretch = 1.25 + Math.random() * 0.8;
    w.rot = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.8;
    return w;
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < STEAM_COUNT; i++) {
    steamWisps.push(spawnSteamWisp({}, true));
  }

  // Delicate rising steam ribbons (sinuous translucent plumes for authentic hot-soup look)
  const steamRibbons = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
    steamRibbons.push({
      baseX: (i - 3) * 0.19 + (rng() - 0.5) * 0.07,
      baseY: (rng() - 0.5) * 0.18,
      phase: rng() * Math.PI * 2,
      speed: 0.55 + rng() * 0.45,
      height: 1.15 + rng() * 0.75,
      width: 0.13 + rng() * 0.11,
      amp: 0.10 + rng() * 0.11,
      alpha: 0.045 + rng() * 0.04,
    });
  }

  // Helper: draw an ellipse path
  function ellipsePath(x, y, rx, ry, rot = 0) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(x, y, Math.max(0.1, rx), Math.max(0.1, ry), rot, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  }

  // --- SCENE DRAWING LAYERS ---

  function drawAtmosphereAndTable(t, lx, ly) {
    // Base dark atmospheric room backdrop
    const bgGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
      cx + lx * bowlR * 0.35, cy - bowlR * 0.55 + ly * bowlR * 0.2, bowlR * 0.1,
      cx, cy, Math.max(width, height) * 0.85
    );
    bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#2a1a10');
    bgGrad.addColorStop(0.28, '#19100b');
    bgGrad.addColorStop(0.62, '#0c0806');
    bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#040303');
    ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);

    // Table surface plane starting gently behind the bowl
    const horizonY = cy - bowlR * 0.62;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.rect(0, horizonY, width, height - horizonY);
    ctx.clip();

    // Tiled procedural dark cedar wood texture with subtle parallax
    if (woodCanvas) {
      const pat = ctx.createPattern(woodCanvas, 'repeat');
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(cx - lx * 14, horizonY - ly * 8);
      ctx.scale(1.15, 0.78);
      ctx.fillStyle = pat;
      ctx.fillRect(-width, -height, width * 2.5, height * 2.5);
      ctx.restore();
    }

    // Warm overhead lantern pool of light across the wooden counter
    const flicker = reducedMotion ? 1 : (0.97 + 0.03 * Math.sin(t * 1.7) * Math.cos(t * 2.9));
    const tablePool = ctx.createRadialGradient(
      cx + lx * bowlR * 0.45, cy + bowlR * 0.08 + ly * bowlR * 0.2, bowlR * 0.2,
      cx + lx * bowlR * 0.2, cy + bowlR * 0.12, bowlR * 2.55
    );
    tablePool.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255, 168, 88, ${(0.18 * flicker).toFixed(3)})`);
    tablePool.addColorStop(0.45, `rgba(165, 92, 42, ${(0.09 * flicker).toFixed(3)})`);
    tablePool.addColorStop(0.78, 'rgba(18, 10, 6, 0.45)');
    tablePool.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(4, 3, 2, 0.92)');
    ctx.fillStyle = tablePool;
    ctx.fillRect(0, horizonY, width, height - horizonY);

    // Horizon soft depth fade so wood merges naturally into the dark background
    const hFade = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, horizonY, 0, horizonY + bowlR * 0.55);
    hFade.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(9, 6, 5, 0.98)');
    hFade.addColorStop(0.45, 'rgba(11, 7, 5, 0.52)');
    hFade.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(11, 7, 5, 0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = hFade;
    ctx.fillRect(0, horizonY, width, bowlR * 0.55);

    ctx.restore();

    // Soft warm backlight halo behind the steam column (izakaya lantern ambience)
    const halo = ctx.createRadialGradient(
      cx + lx * bowlR * 0.3, cy - bowlR * 0.72 + ly * bowlR * 0.15, bowlR * 0.05,
      cx + lx * bowlR * 0.2, cy - bowlR * 0.55, bowlR * 1.85
    );
    halo.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255, 174, 96, ${(0.12 * flicker).toFixed(3)})`);
    halo.addColorStop(0.45, `rgba(210, 118, 52, ${(0.055 * flicker).toFixed(3)})`);
    halo.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = halo;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
  }

  function drawWovenMatAndShadows(lx, ly) {
    // Subtle dark bamboo/linen placemat circle beneath the bowl for grounded staging
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(cx - lx * 5, cy + bowlR * 0.26 - ly * 3);

    // Deep ambient occlusion shadow directly beneath bowl foot
    const shadowGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
      -lx * 20, bowlR * 0.18 - ly * 10, bowlR * 0.22,
      -lx * 24, bowlR * 0.18 - ly * 12, bowlR * 1.38
    );
    shadowGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.92)');
    shadowGrad.addColorStop(0.48, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.68)');
    shadowGrad.addColorStop(0.78, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.24)');
    shadowGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');

  // Draw the rich vegan ramen interior clipped cleanly inside the bowl rim
  function drawRamenContents(t, lx, ly) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(cx, cy);

    const outerRx = bowlR * 1.03;
    const outerRy = bowlR * 1.03 * tiltY;
    const rimThickness = bowlR * 0.055;
    const innerRx = outerRx - rimThickness;
    const innerRy = outerRy - rimThickness * tiltY;

    // Soup surface ellipse sits slightly below the rim (realistic meniscus depth)
    const brothY = bowlR * 0.088;
    const brothRx = innerRx * 0.965;
    const brothRy = innerRy * 0.92;

    // 1. Back Nori Sheets (tucked into the upper-right rim, protruding above the bowl edge!)
    // Drawn BEFORE the broth clip so they naturally rise up past the back rim
    drawNoriSheets(t, lx, ly, innerRx, innerRy);

    // Clip to inner bowl opening (allowing toppings to overlap back inner wall, but stay cleanly inside front rim)
    ctx.save();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, 0, innerRx, innerRy, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.clip();

    // 2. Creamy Rich Golden Miso / Sesame Broth
    ctx.save();
    ellipsePath(0, brothY, brothRx, brothRy);
    ctx.clip();

    const simmer = reducedMotion ? 0 : Math.sin(t * 1.35) * 0.015;
    const brothGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
      -brothRx * 0.14 + lx * bowlR * 0.22,

    brothGrad.addColorStop(0.68, '#874312');
    brothGrad.addColorStop(0.92, '#5a2709');
    brothGrad.addColorStop(1, '#3b1705');
    ctx.fillStyle = brothGrad;
    ctx.fillRect(-brothRx, brothY - brothRy, brothRx * 2, brothRy * 2);

    // Soft swirling miso / chili-oil clouding inside the broth
    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
      const a = i * 1.08 + (reducedMotion ? 0 : t * 0.08 * (i % 2 === 0 ? 1 : -1));
      const sx = Math.cos(a) * brothRx * 0.36;
      const sy = brothY + Math.sin(a) * brothRy * 0.34;
      const sr = bowlR * (0.28 + (i % 3) * 0.08);
      const swGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(sx, sy, 0, sx, sy, sr);
      if (i % 2 === 0) {
        swGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(246, 178, 86, 0.16)');

        swGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(176, 48, 12, 0)');
      }
      ctx.fillStyle = swGrad;
      ellipsePath(sx, sy, sr, sr * tiltY);
      ctx.fill();

    // Subtle simmering convection glow waves
    if (!reducedMotion) {
      for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        const phase = (t * 0.24 + i * 0.33) % 1;
        const r = phase * brothRx * 0.88;
        const alpha = Math.sin(phase * Math.PI) * 0.065;
        ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255, 220, 155, ${alpha.toFixed(3)})`;

        ellipsePath(Math.sin(t * 0.5 + i) * 6, brothY + Math.cos(t * 0.4 + i) * 3, r, r * tiltY * 0.94);
        ctx.stroke();
      }

    // 3. Submerged Ramen Noodles (layer 0 - softly visible beneath golden broth)

    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(162, 84, 24, 0.28)';
    ellipsePath(0, brothY, brothRx, brothRy);
    ctx.fill();

    drawNoodles(t, brothY, 1);

    // 5. Floating Chili Oil (Rayu) & Golden Sesame Oil Droplets
    drawOilDroplets(t, brothY, lx, ly);

    // 6. Interactive Ripples on the broth surface
    drawRipples(brothY);

    // 7. Meniscus edge shadow & bright wet highlight around the broth perimeter
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(28, 10, 3, 0.55)';
    ctx.lineWidth = bowlR * 0.032;
    ellipsePath(0, brothY, brothRx * 0.995, brothRy * 0.995);
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255, 212, 148, ${(0.22 + simmer).toFixed(3)})`;
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.6;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, brothY, brothRx * 0.978, brothRy * 0.978, 0, -Math.PI * 0.85, -Math.PI * 0.15);
    ctx.stroke();

    // Broad soft specular sheen on broth surface moving subtly with cursor
    const sheenX = -brothRx * 0.24 + lx * bowlR * 0.26;
    const sheenY = brothY - brothRy * 0.22 + ly * bowlR * 0.18;
    const sheenGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(sheenX, sheenY, bowlR * 0.02, sheenX, sheenY, bowlR * 0.56);
    sheenGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 232, 185, 0.24)');
    sheenGrad.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255, 195, 120, 0.08)');
    sheenGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 195, 120, 0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = sheenGrad;
    ellipsePath(sheenX, sheenY, bowlR * 0.56, bowlR * 0.56 * tiltY);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.restore(); // end broth clip

    // 8. Vegan Toppings (layered back-to-front with gentle buoyant motion)
    drawBokChoy(t, brothY, lx, ly);
    drawCornCluster(t, brothY);
    drawWoodEarMushrooms(t, brothY, lx, ly);
    drawSearedTofuSlices(t, brothY, lx, ly);
    drawShiitakeCaps(t, brothY, lx, ly);
    drawNarutomakiVeganRadishAndChiliThreads(t, brothY, lx, ly);

    drawSesameSeeds(t, brothY);

    // Subtle inner shadow cast by the front rim onto the front edge of the soup
    const frontRimShadow = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, innerRx * 0.72, 0, 0, innerRx * 1.02);
    frontRimShadow.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');
    frontRimShadow.addColorStop(0.84, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');
    frontRimShadow.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(10, 5, 3, 0.65)');
    ctx.fillStyle = frontRimShadow;
    ellipsePath(0, 0, innerRx, innerRy);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.restore(); // end inner bowl clip

    // 9. Crisp Stoneware Rim Highlight (drawn on top to seat the soup cleanly inside the bowl)
    drawBowlRimHighlight(outerRx, outerRy, innerRx, innerRy, lx, ly);

    ctx.restore();

  function drawNoodles(t, brothY, targetLayer) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.lineCap = 'round';
    ctx.lineJoin = 'round';

    for (let i = 0; i < noodleStrands.length; i++) {
      const n = noodleStrands[i];
      if (n.layer !== targetLayer) continue;

      const drift = reducedMotion ? 0 : Math.sin(t * 0.9 + n.phase) * 0.008;
      const steps = 18;

      ctx.beginPath();
      for (let s = 0; s <= steps; s++) {
        const u = s / steps;
        const ang = n.baseAngle + u * n.arcSpan;
        const wave = Math.sin(u * n.waveFreq * Math.PI + n.phase + (reducedMotion ? 0 : t * 0.5)) * n.waveAmp;
        const r = (n.rad + wave) * bowlR;
        const x = (n.offsetX + drift) * bowlR + Math.cos(ang) * r;
        const y = brothY + (n.offsetY + drift * 0.5) * bowlR * tiltY + Math.sin(ang) * r * tiltY;
        if (s === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y);
        else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
      }

      const lw = n.thickness * bowlR;
      if (targetLayer === 0) {
        // Submerged noodles: warm amber-tinted & softer
        ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(215, 152, 68, ${(0.34 * n.shade).toFixed(3)})`;
        ctx.lineWidth = lw * 1.1;
        ctx.stroke();
      } else {
        // Surface noodles: cast shadow + pale golden wheat body + wet specular line
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(72, 32, 8, 0.45)';
        ctx.lineWidth = lw * 1.28;
        ctx.stroke();

        const rCol = Math.min(255, Math.round(238 * n.shade));
        const gCol = Math.min(255, Math.round(196 * n.shade));
        const bCol = Math.min(255, Math.round(112 * n.shade));
        ctx.strokeStyle = `rgb(${rCol}, ${gCol}, ${bCol})`;
        ctx.lineWidth = lw;
        ctx.stroke();

        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 246, 214, 0.42)';
        ctx.lineWidth = lw * 0.28;
        ctx.stroke();
      }
    }

    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawOilDroplets(t, brothY, lx, ly) {
    for (let i = 0; i < oilDroplets.length; i++) {
      const d = oilDroplets[i];
      const wobbleX = reducedMotion ? 0 : Math.cos(t * d.speed + d.phase) * d.driftR;
      const wobbleY = reducedMotion ? 0 : Math.sin(t * d.speed * 0.8 + d.phase) * d.driftR * tiltY;
      const x = (d.x + wobbleX) * bowlR;
      const y = brothY + (d.y + wobbleY) * bowlR;
      const r = d.r * bowlR;

      const nVal = noise2(w.x * 2.4 + t * 0.28, w.y * 2.0 - t * 0.32) - 0.5;
      const curl = Math.sin(w.age * w.curlFreq + w.phase) * w.curlAmp * 0.5 + nVal * 0.26;

      if (pointer.active) {
        const sx = cx + w.x * bowlR;
        const sy = cy + w.y * bowlR;
        const dx = sx - pointer.px;
        const dy = sy - pointer.py;
        const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
        const interactR = bowlR * 0.72;
        if (dist < interactR && dist > 1) {
          const force = Math.pow(1 - dist / interactR, 1.7);
          // Carry steam along cursor velocity + gentle parting away from cursor center
          w.vx += (pointer.vx / bowlR) * force * dt * 1.15;
          w.vy += (pointer.vy / bowlR) * force * dt * 0.55;
          w.vx += (dx / dist) * force * dt * 0.65;
        }
      }

      // Dampen interactive velocity back toward natural buoyant plume
      w.vx += (windX + curl - w.vx) * Math.min(1, dt * 1.6);
      w.vy += (-(0.28 + progress * 0.16) - w.vy) * Math.min(1, dt * 1.1);

      w.x += w.vx * dt;
      w.y += w.vy * dt;
      w.rot += (w.vx * 0.6 + nVal * 0.3) * dt;
    }

    // Update interactive broth ripples
    for (let i = ripples.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const rp = ripples[i];
      rp.r += rp.speed * dt;
      rp.alpha *= Math.pow(0.18, dt);
      if (rp.r >= rp.maxR || rp.alpha < 0.01) {
        ripples.splice(i, 1);
      }
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < motes.length; i++) {
      const m = motes[i];
      m.x += (m.vx + Math.sin(t * 0.6 + m.phase) * 0.004) * dt;
      m.y += m.vy * dt;
      if (m.y < -0.05) {
        m.y = 1.05;
        m.x = Math.random();
      }
      if (m.x < -0.05) m.x = 1.05;
      if (m.x > 1.05) m.x = -0.05;

    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'screen';

    // 1. Sinuous soft rising steam ribbons (gives graceful cohesive curling plumes)
    for (let i = 0; i < steamRibbons.length; i++) {
      const rb = steamRibbons[i];
      const timeVal = reducedMotion ? 1.8 : t * rb.speed;
      const segs = 16;
      const baseX = cx + rb.baseX * bowlR;
      const baseY = cy + (0.04 + rb.baseY * tiltY) * bowlR;
      const plumeH = rb.height * bowlR;

      // Build spine points
      const pts = [];
      for (let s = 0; s <= segs; s++) {
        const u = s / segs; // 0 at broth -> 1 high in air
        const sway =
          Math.sin(u * 4.4 - timeVal + rb.phase) * rb.amp * bowlR * (0.2 + u * 1.1) +
          Math.cos(u * 2.3 - timeVal * 0.65 + rb.phase) * rb.amp * bowlR * 0.45 * u;
        let px = baseX + sway + lx * bowlR * 0.16 * u;
        let py = baseY - u * plumeH;

        // Subtle cursor deflection on ribbon spine
        if (pointer.active && !reducedMotion) {
          const dx = px - pointer.px;
          const dy = py - pointer.py;
          const d = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
          const rad = bowlR * 0.78;
          if (d < rad && d > 1) {
            const push = Math.pow(1 - d / rad, 2) * bowlR * 0.18 * u;
            px += (dx / d) * push;
          }
        }
        pts.push({ x: px, y: py, u });
      }

      // Render multi-pass blurred ribbon stroke for silky atmospheric wisps
      for (let s = 1; s < pts.length; s++) {
        const p0 = pts[s - 1];
        const p1 = pts[s];
        const u = (p0.u + p1.u) * 0.5;
        const env = Math.sin(u * Math.PI) * Math.pow(1 - u, 0.45);
        const w = rb.width * bowlR * (0.45 + u * 1.65);
        const alpha = rb.alpha * env;
        if (alpha < 0.002) continue;

        const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(p1.x, p1.y, 0, p1.x, p1.y, w);
        g.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255, 240, 222, ${(alpha * 1.05).toFixed(4)})`);
        g.addColorStop(0.5, `rgba(236, 212, 186, ${(alpha * 0.42).toFixed(4)})`);
        g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(210, 180, 150, 0)');
        ctx.fillStyle = g;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(p1.x, p1.y, w, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
      }
    }

    // 2. Volumetric curling steam wisps (interactive particles rising from the hot broth)
    for (let i = 0; i < steamWisps.length; i++) {
      const w = steamWisps[i];
      const p = w.age / w.life;
      // Smooth fade-in from broth surface, gradual airy dissipation overhead
      const env = Math.pow(Math.sin(Math.min(1, p) * Math.PI), 1.15) * (1 - p * 0.38);
      const alpha = w.opacity * env;
      if (alpha < 0.002) continue;

      const x = cx + w.x * bowlR;
      const y = cy + w.y * bowlR;
      const radius = w.size * bowlR * (0.55 + p * 1.65);

      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(x, y);
      ctx.rotate(w.rot);
      ctx.scale(1, w.stretch);

      // Warm backlit cream tint near the bowl, cooling slightly as it rises
      const rCol = Math.round(255 - p * 18);
      const gCol = Math.round(238 - p * 22);
      const bCol = Math.round(216 - p * 12);

      const sg = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, radius);
      sg.addColorStop(0, `rgba(${rCol}, ${gCol}, ${bCol}, ${alpha.toFixed(4)})`);
      sg.addColorStop(0.48, `rgba(${rCol - 15}, ${gCol - 20}, ${bCol - 18}, ${(alpha * 0.46).toFixed(4)})`);
      sg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(200, 175, 150, 0)');

      ctx.fillStyle = sg;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(0, 0, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.restore();
    }

    ctx.restore();
  }

    // Warm floating light motes drifting softly in the izakaya air
    ctx.save();
    for (let i = 0; i < motes.length; i++) {
      const m = motes[i];
      const mx = m.x * width + lx * 18 * (0.4 + m.warmth);
      const my = m.y * height + ly * 12 * (0.4 + m.warmth);
      const distToBowl = Math.hypot(mx - cx, my - (cy - bowlR * 0.35));
      const warmBoost = Math.max(0.15, 1 - distToBowl / (bowlR * 2.8));
      const twinkle = reducedMotion ? 0.85 : (0.65 + 0.35 * Math.sin(t * 1.9 + m.phase));
      const a = m.alpha * warmBoost * twinkle;
      if (a < 0.015) continue;

      const mg = ctx.createRadialGradient(mx, my, 0, mx, my, m.r * 2.6);
      mg.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255, 212, 152, ${a.toFixed(3)})`);
      mg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 180, 100, 0)');
      ctx.fillStyle = mg;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(mx, my, m.r * 2.6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.restore();

    // Cinematic warm-dark vignette framing the bowl as the sole visual hero
    const vig = ctx.createRadialGradient(
      cx, cy - bowlR * 0.08, bowlR * 0.92,
      cx, cy, Math.max(width, height) * 0.78
    );
    vig.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');
    vig.addColorStop(0.62, 'rgba(5, 3, 2, 0.24)');
    vig.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(2, 1, 1, 0.82)');
    ctx.fillStyle = vig;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);

    // Subtle analog film grain for tactile photographic warmth
    if (grainPattern) {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'overlay';
      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.35;
      ctx.fillStyle = grainPattern;
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
      ctx.restore();
    }
  }

  function renderFrame(t, dt) {
    // Smooth cursor tracking & decay velocity
    const ease = reducedMotion ? 1 : Math.min(1, dt * 4.5);
    const targetX = pointer.active ? pointer.nx : (reducedMotion ? 0 : Math.sin(t * 0.35) * 0.12);
    const targetY = pointer.active ? pointer.ny : (reducedMotion ? 0 : Math.cos(t * 0.27) * 0.08);
    pointer.tx += (targetX - pointer.tx) * ease;
    pointer.ty += (targetY - pointer.ty) * ease;
    pointer.vx *= Math.pow(0.05, dt);
    pointer.vy *= Math.pow(0.05, dt);

    const lx = reducedMotion ? 0 : pointer.tx;
    const ly = reducedMotion ? 0 : pointer.ty;

    updateSteam(dt, t);

    drawAtmosphereAndTable(t, lx, ly);
    drawWovenMatAndShadows(lx, ly);
    drawChopsticks(t, lx, ly);
    drawCeramicBowlExterior(lx, ly);
    drawRamenContents(t, lx, ly);
    drawSteam(t, lx, ly);
    drawAmbientMotesAndVignette(t, lx, ly);
  }

  // Animation loop
  let lastTime = performance.now();
  function tick(now) {
    const dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - lastTime) / 1000);
    lastTime = now;

    if (!reducedMotion) {
      renderFrame(now * 0.001, dt);
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }

  // Initialize
  buildProceduralTextures();
  resize();
  window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
  renderFrame(0, 0.016);
  requestAnimationFrame(tick);
})();

<main aria-label="A steaming bowl of vegan ramen in dark warm atmospheric lighting">
  <canvas id="scene"></canvas>
</main>
<script>
(() => {
  'use strict';

  const canvas = document.getElementById('scene');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d', { alpha: false });

  // Respect prefers-reduced-motion dynamically
  const reducedMotionQuery = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
  let reducedMotion = reducedMotionQuery.matches;
  reducedMotionQuery.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
    reducedMotion = e.matches;
    if (reducedMotion) {
      renderFrame(0, 0);
    }
  });

  // Deterministic PRNG for organic procedural textures & ingredient placements
  function mulberry32(seed) {
    return function () {
      let t = (seed += 0x6d2b79f5);
      t = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), t | 1);
      t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), t | 61);
      return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
    };
  }

  // Smooth value noise for organic broth shimmer & steam curl
  function hash2(x, y) {
    const n = Math.sin(x * 127.1 + y * 311.7) * 43758.5453123;
    return n - Math.floor(n);
  }
  function noise2(x, y) {
    const ix = Math.floor(x), iy = Math.floor(y);
    const fx = x - ix, fy = y - iy;
    const ux = fx * fx * (3 - 2 * fx);
    const uy = fy * fy * (3 - 2 * fy);
    const a = hash2(ix, iy);
    const b = hash2(ix + 1, iy);
    const c = hash2(ix, iy + 1);
    const d = hash2(ix + 1, iy + 1);
    return a + (b - a) * ux + (c - a) * uy + (a - b - c + d) * ux * uy;
  }

  // Offscreen cached procedural textures
  let woodCanvas = null;
  let grainPattern = null;
  let ceramicSpeckleCanvas = null;
  let noriCanvas = null;

  function buildProceduralTextures() {
    // 1. Dark charred cedar (shou sugi ban) counter texture
    woodCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    woodCanvas.width = 512;
    woodCanvas.height = 512;
    const wctx = woodCanvas.getContext('2d');
    const wrng = mulberry32(4109);

    const wgrad = wctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, 512);
    wgrad.addColorStop(0, '#120c09');
    wgrad.addColorStop(0.5, '#18100c');
    wgrad.addColorStop(1, '#0c0806');
    wctx.fillStyle = wgrad;
    wctx.fillRect(0, 0, 512, 512);

    for (let y = 0; y < 512; y += 2) {
      const wave = Math.sin(y * 0.045) * 0.5 + Math.sin(y * 0.13 + 1.4) * 0.35;
      const alpha = 0.025 + Math.abs(wave) * 0.042;
      wctx.fillStyle = wave > 0
        ? `rgba(88, 54, 32, ${alpha.toFixed(3)})`
        : `rgba(4, 2, 1, ${(alpha * 1.45).toFixed(3)})`;
      wctx.fillRect(0, y, 512, 1.5);
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < 460; i++) {
      const y = wrng() * 512;
      const x = wrng() * 512;
      const len = 45 + wrng() * 210;
      const thickness = 0.5 + wrng() * 1.3;
      wctx.strokeStyle = wrng() > 0.45
        ? `rgba(76, 46, 28, ${(0.03 + wrng() * 0.055).toFixed(3)})`
        : `rgba(4, 2, 1, ${(0.06 + wrng() * 0.09).toFixed(3)})`;
      wctx.lineWidth = thickness;
      wctx.beginPath();
      wctx.moveTo(x, y);
      wctx.bezierCurveTo(
        x + len * 0.33, y + (wrng() - 0.5) * 4,
        x + len * 0.66, y + (wrng() - 0.5) * 4,
        x + len, y + (wrng() - 0.5) * 2
      );
      wctx.stroke();
    }

    wctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(2, 1, 1, 0.48)';
    wctx.lineWidth = 2;
    wctx.beginPath();
    wctx.moveTo(0, 295);
    wctx.lineTo(512, 297);
    wctx.stroke();

    // 2. Handcrafted iron-fleck ceramic glaze texture
    ceramicSpeckleCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    ceramicSpeckleCanvas.width = 256;
    ceramicSpeckleCanvas.height = 256;
    const cctx = ceramicSpeckleCanvas.getContext('2d');
    const crng = mulberry32(9901);

    for (let i = 0; i < 1200; i++) {
      const x = crng() * 256;
      const y = crng() * 256;
      const r = 0.4 + crng() * 1.4;
      const pick = crng();
      if (pick < 0.55) {
        cctx.fillStyle = `rgba(196, 158, 118, ${(0.03 + crng() * 0.075).toFixed(3)})`;
      } else if (pick < 0.85) {
        cctx.fillStyle = `rgba(10, 8, 7, ${(0.12 + crng() * 0.18).toFixed(3)})`;
      } else {
        cctx.fillStyle = `rgba(136, 92, 54, ${(0.06 + crng() * 0.095).toFixed(3)})`;
      }
      cctx.beginPath();
      cctx.arc(x, y, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      cctx.fill();
    }

    // 3. Toasted Nori fibrous seaweed texture
    noriCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    noriCanvas.width = 128;
    noriCanvas.height = 128;
    const nctx = noriCanvas.getContext('2d');
    const nrng = mulberry32(7712);
    nctx.fillStyle = '#0b150c';
    nctx.fillRect(0, 0, 128, 128);
    for (let i = 0; i < 720; i++) {
      const x = nrng() * 128;
      const y = nrng() * 128;
      const w = 1.2 + nrng() * 6.5;
      const h = 0.6 + nrng() * 1.5;
      const g = Math.floor(22 + nrng() * 32);
      nctx.fillStyle = `rgba(${Math.floor(g * 0.55)}, ${g + 10}, ${Math.floor(g * 0.45)}, ${(0.18 + nrng() * 0.28).toFixed(3)})`;
      nctx.save();
      nctx.translate(x, y);
      nctx.rotate((nrng() - 0.5) * 1.5);
      nctx.fillRect(-w / 2, -h / 2, w, h);
      nctx.restore();
    }

    // 4. Subtle photographic film grain
    const gCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    gCanvas.width = 160;
    gCanvas.height = 160;
    const gctx = gCanvas.getContext('2d');
    const imgData = gctx.createImageData(160, 160);
    const grng = mulberry32(2026);
    for (let i = 0; i < imgData.data.length; i += 4) {
      const v = Math.floor(grng() * 255);
      imgData.data[i] = v;
      imgData.data[i + 1] = v;
      imgData.data[i + 2] = v;
      imgData.data[i + 3] = 10;
    }
    gctx.putImageData(imgData, 0, 0);
    grainPattern = ctx.createPattern(gCanvas, 'repeat');
  }

  // Responsive layout metrics
  let width = 1280;
  let height = 800;
  let dpr = 1;
  let cx = 640;
  let cy = 440;
  let bowlR = 230;
  const tiltY = 0.72;

  function resize() {
    dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
    width = window.innerWidth;
    height = window.innerHeight;
    canvas.width = Math.round(width * dpr);
    canvas.height = Math.round(height * dpr);
    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);

    const minDim = Math.min(width, height);
    const isPortrait = height > width * 1.08;
    bowlR = Math.max(105, Math.min(minDim * (isPortrait ? 0.36 : 0.33), 275));
    cx = width * 0.5;
    cy = height * (isPortrait ? 0.56 : 0.55);

    if (reducedMotion) {
      renderFrame(0, 0);
    }
  }

  // Interactive pointer state
  const pointer = {
    nx: 0,
    ny: 0,
    tx: 0,
    ty: 0,
    vx: 0,
    vy: 0,
    px: 0,
    py: 0,
    active: false,
    overBowl: false,
  };

  // Interactive broth ripples
  const ripples = [];
  let lastRippleTime = 0;

  function addRipple(bx, by, strength = 1) {
    if (reducedMotion) return;
    const dist = Math.hypot(bx, by / tiltY);
    if (dist > bowlR * 0.88) return;
    ripples.push({
      x: bx,
      y: by,
      r: 4,
      maxR: bowlR * (0.32 + strength * 0.34),
      alpha: 0.44 * strength,
      speed: 55 + strength * 35,
    });
    if (ripples.length > 10) ripples.shift();
  }

  function updatePointerPos(clientX, clientY, isClick = false) {
    const dx = clientX - pointer.px;
    const dy = clientY - pointer.py;
    pointer.px = clientX;
    pointer.py = clientY;
    pointer.vx = pointer.vx * 0.65 + dx * 18;
    pointer.vy = pointer.vy * 0.65 + dy * 18;
    pointer.nx = (clientX / width - 0.5) * 2;
    pointer.ny = (clientY / height - 0.5) * 2;
    pointer.active = true;

    const relX = clientX - cx;
    const relY = clientY - cy;
    const bowlDist = Math.hypot(relX / (bowlR * 0.9), relY / (bowlR * 0.9 * tiltY));
    pointer.overBowl = bowlDist < 1.0;

    const now = performance.now();
    if (isClick && bowlDist < 0.95) {
      addRipple(relX, relY, 1.4);
      for (const s of steamWisps) {
        const sx = cx + s.x * bowlR;
        const sy = cy + s.y * bowlR;
        const d = Math.hypot(sx - clientX, sy - clientY);
        if (d < bowlR * 0.95) {
          const push = (1 - d / (bowlR * 0.95)) * 1.25;
          s.vx += ((sx - clientX) / (d + 20)) * push * 0.85;
          s.vy -= push * 0.38;
        }
      }
    } else if (pointer.overBowl && Math.hypot(dx, dy) > 3.5 && now - lastRippleTime > 165) {
      addRipple(relX, relY, 0.72);
      lastRippleTime = now;
    }
  }

  window.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => {
    updatePointerPos(e.clientX, e.clientY, false);
  }, { passive: true });

  window.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
    updatePointerPos(e.clientX, e.clientY, true);
  }, { passive: true });

  window.addEventListener('pointerleave', () => {
    pointer.active = false;
    pointer.overBowl = false;
  });

  // Deterministic procedural ingredient geometry
  const rng = mulberry32(20261118);

  // Chili oil (rayu) & golden sesame oil pearls
  const oilDroplets = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 68; i++) {
    const angle = rng() * Math.PI * 2;
    const rad = Math.sqrt(rng()) * 0.84;
    const isChili = rng() < 0.5;
    oilDroplets.push({
      x: Math.cos(angle) * rad,
      y: Math.sin(angle) * rad * tiltY,
      r: (isChili ? 0.014 : 0.011) + Math.pow(rng(), 2.1) * 0.036,
      isChili,
      phase: rng() * Math.PI * 2,
      speed: 0.4 + rng() * 0.7,
      driftR: 0.004 + rng() * 0.008,
    });
  }

  // White & black toasted sesame seeds
  const sesameSeeds = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 62; i++) {
    const angle = rng() * Math.PI * 2;
    const rad = 0.05 + Math.sqrt(rng()) * 0.76;
    sesameSeeds.push({
      x: Math.cos(angle) * rad,
      y: Math.sin(angle) * rad * tiltY,
      rot: rng() * Math.PI * 2,
      isBlack: rng() < 0.34,
      size: 0.0085 + rng() * 0.005,
      phase: rng() * Math.PI * 2,
    });
  }

  // Fresh scallion rings
  const scallions = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 24; i++) {
    const cluster = i < 14;
    const a = rng() * Math.PI * 2;
    const r = cluster ? (0.04 + rng() * 0.25) : (0.36 + rng() * 0.42);
    const ox = cluster ? 0.05 : 0;
    const oy = cluster ? 0.06 : 0;
    scallions.push({
      x: ox + Math.cos(a) * r,
      y: (oy + Math.sin(a) * r) * tiltY,
      r: 0.033 + rng() * 0.021,
      tilt: (rng() - 0.5) * 0.55,
      rot: rng() * Math.PI,
      phase: rng() * Math.PI * 2,
      bobAmp: 0.004 + rng() * 0.004,
      bright: 0.8 + rng() * 0.35,
    });
  }

  // Sweet golden corn kernels clustered on lower-left
  const cornKernels = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 36; i++) {
    const a = rng() * Math.PI * 2;
    const r = Math.sqrt(rng()) * 0.24;
    cornKernels.push({
      x: -0.34 + Math.cos(a) * r * 1.04,
      y: (0.29 + Math.sin(a) * r * 0.72) * tiltY,
      rot: rng() * Math.PI * 2,
      s: 0.028 + rng() * 0.011,
      phase: rng() * Math.PI * 2,
    });
  }

  // Wavy golden ramen noodles: layered submerged + cohesive folded noodle nest in the lower-center
  const noodleStrands = [];
  // Layer 0: submerged strands distributed throughout the bowl
  for (let i = 0; i < 22; i++) {
    noodleStrands.push({
      layer: 0,
      baseAngle: -2.4 + (i / 22) * 5.2 + (rng() - 0.5) * 0.4,
      arcSpan: 0.85 + rng() * 1.3,
      rad: 0.16 + rng() * 0.58,
      waveFreq: 5 + rng() * 5,
      waveAmp: 0.018 + rng() * 0.022,
      offsetX: (rng() - 0.5) * 0.24,
      offsetY: (rng() - 0.5) * 0.2,
      thickness: 0.015 + rng() * 0.006,
      phase: rng() * Math.PI * 2,
      shade: 0.85 + rng() * 0.28,
    });
  }
  // Layer 1: folded parallel-sweeping golden noodle bundle peeking cleanly out of the broth in center-front
  for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
    const lane = (i / 15) - 0.5;
    noodleStrands.push({
      layer: 1,
      lane,
      phase: rng() * Math.PI * 2,
      waveFreq: 3.8 + rng() * 1.6,
      waveAmp: 0.014 + rng() * 0.012,
      thickness: 0.0165 + rng() * 0.0045,
      shade: 0.88 + rng() * 0.22,
      yShift: (rng() - 0.5) * 0.035,
    });
  }

  // Ambient floating warm kitchen light motes
  const motes = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
    motes.push({
      x: rng(),
      y: rng(),
      r: 0.8 + rng() * 2.1,
      vx: (rng() - 0.5) * 0.008,
      vy: -0.004 - rng() * 0.012,
      alpha: 0.09 + rng() * 0.25,
      phase: rng() * Math.PI * 2,
      warmth: rng(),
    });
  }

  // Organic steam system: volumetric curling wisps + wispy ribbons
  const steamWisps = [];
  const STEAM_COUNT = 64;
  function spawnSteamWisp(w, randomAge = false) {
    const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    const dist = Math.sqrt(Math.random()) * 0.56;
    w.x = Math.cos(angle) * dist;
    w.y = Math.sin(angle) * dist * tiltY - 0.03;
    w.vx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.07;
    w.vy = -(0.26 + Math.random() * 0.24);
    w.age = randomAge ? Math.random() * 4.2 : 0;
    w.life = 3.0 + Math.random() * 2.8;
    w.size = 0.13 + Math.random() * 0.21;
    w.curlFreq = 1.2 + Math.random() * 1.5;
    w.curlAmp = 0.10 + Math.random() * 0.16;
    w.phase = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    w.opacity = 0.08 + Math.random() * 0.085;
    w.stretch = 1.3 + Math.random() * 0.85;
    w.rot = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.8;
    return w;
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < STEAM_COUNT; i++) {
    steamWisps.push(spawnSteamWisp({}, true));
  }

  // Delicate curling tendrils of rising steam (gives unmistakable hot-broth silhouette)
  const steamRibbons = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
    steamRibbons.push({
      baseX: (i - 4) * 0.145 + (rng() - 0.5) * 0.06,
      baseY: (rng() - 0.5) * 0.20,
      phase: rng() * Math.PI * 2,
      speed: 0.6 + rng() * 0.48,
      height: 1.25 + rng() * 0.82,
      width: 0.085 + rng() * 0.085,
      amp: 0.11 + rng() * 0.11,
      alpha: 0.068 + rng() * 0.055,
    });
  }

  function ellipsePath(x, y, rx, ry, rot = 0) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(x, y, Math.max(0.1, rx), Math.max(0.1, ry), rot, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  }

  // --- DRAWING LAYERS ---

  function drawAtmosphereAndTable(t, lx, ly) {
    // Rich dark izakaya backdrop with warm overhead lantern glow
    const bgGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
      cx + lx * bowlR * 0.35, cy - bowlR * 0.58 + ly * bowlR * 0.2, bowlR * 0.08,
      cx, cy, Math.max(width, height) * 0.86
    );
    bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#2d1c11');
    bgGrad.addColorStop(0.28, '#1a100a');
    bgGrad.addColorStop(0.62, '#0b0705');
    bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#040303');
    ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);

    // Dark charred-cedar tabletop horizon
    const horizonY = cy - bowlR * 0.62;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.rect(0, horizonY, width, height - horizonY);
    ctx.clip();

    if (woodCanvas) {
      const pat = ctx.createPattern(woodCanvas, 'repeat');
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(cx - lx * 14, horizonY - ly * 8);
      ctx.scale(1.15, 0.78);
      ctx.fillStyle = pat;
      ctx.fillRect(-width, -height, width * 2.5, height * 2.5);
      ctx.restore();
    }

    const flicker = reducedMotion ? 1 : (0.97 + 0.03 * Math.sin(t * 1.7) * Math.cos(t * 2.9));
    const tablePool = ctx.createRadialGradient(
      cx + lx * bowlR * 0.45, cy + bowlR * 0.08 + ly * bowlR * 0.2, bowlR * 0.18,
      cx + lx * bowlR * 0.2, cy + bowlR * 0.12, bowlR * 2.55
    );
    tablePool.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255, 170, 88, ${(0.20 * flicker).toFixed(3)})`);
    tablePool.addColorStop(0.45, `rgba(165, 92, 42, ${(0.095 * flicker).toFixed(3)})`);
    tablePool.addColorStop(0.78, 'rgba(18, 10, 6, 0.46)');
    tablePool.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(4, 3, 2, 0.94)');
    ctx.fillStyle = tablePool;
    ctx.fillRect(0, horizonY, width, height - horizonY);

    const hFade = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, horizonY, 0, horizonY + bowlR * 0.56);
    hFade.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(9, 6, 5, 0.98)');
    hFade.addColorStop(0.46, 'rgba(11, 7, 5, 0.52)');
    hFade.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(11, 7, 5, 0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = hFade;
    ctx.fillRect(0, horizonY, width, bowlR * 0.56);

    ctx.restore();

    // Warm backlit lantern haze behind the rising steam plume
    const halo = ctx.createRadialGradient(
      cx + lx * bowlR * 0.3, cy - bowlR * 0.78 + ly * bowlR * 0.16, bowlR * 0.05,
      cx + lx * bowlR * 0.2, cy - bowlR * 0.58, bowlR * 1.95
    );
    halo.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255, 178, 100, ${(0.145 * flicker).toFixed(3)})`);
    halo.addColorStop(0.45, `rgba(210, 118, 52, ${(0.062 * flicker).toFixed(3)})`);
    halo.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = halo;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
  }

  function drawGroundedShadows(lx, ly) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(cx - lx * 5, cy + bowlR * 0.26 - ly * 3);

    // Broad soft ambient shadow under the bowl
    const shadowGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
      -lx * 20, bowlR * 0.18 - ly * 10, bowlR * 0.22,
      -lx * 24, bowlR * 0.18 - ly * 12, bowlR * 1.38
    );
    shadowGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.94)');
    shadowGrad.addColorStop(0.48, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.68)');
    shadowGrad.addColorStop(0.78, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.24)');
    shadowGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = shadowGrad;
    ellipsePath(-lx * 18, bowlR * 0.12, bowlR * 1.35, bowlR * 1.35 * tiltY * 0.92);
    ctx.fill();

    // Deep contact occlusion under ceramic base foot
    const baseShadow = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, bowlR * 0.36, bowlR * 0.1, 0, bowlR * 0.36, bowlR * 0.78);
    baseShadow.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.96)');
    baseShadow.addColorStop(0.65, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.56)');
    baseShadow.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = baseShadow;
    ellipsePath(0, bowlR * 0.36, bowlR * 0.78, bowlR * 0.42);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawChopsticks(t, lx, ly) {
    // Only render on wider viewports or subtly tuck closer on narrow portrait screens so they never clip awkwardly
    const compact = width < 520;
    const xScale = compact ? 0.74 : 1.0;

    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(cx - lx * 6, cy - ly * 4);

    const hoverShift = pointer.active ? Math.max(0, (pointer.tx - 0.15) * 3) : 0;

    // Small ceramic chopstick rest (hashioki)
    const restX = bowlR * 1.02 * xScale;
    const restY = bowlR * (compact ? 0.88 : 0.56);
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(restX, restY);
    ctx.rotate(compact ? -0.08 : -0.22);

    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55)';
    ellipsePath(4, 9, bowlR * 0.14, bowlR * 0.05);
    ctx.fill();

    const restGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(-bowlR * 0.13, -bowlR * 0.04, bowlR * 0.13, bowlR * 0.05);
    restGrad.addColorStop(0, '#44352d');
    restGrad.addColorStop(0.45, '#2b201b');
    restGrad.addColorStop(1, '#140f0d');
    ctx.fillStyle = restGrad;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.roundRect(-bowlR * 0.125, -bowlR * 0.04, bowlR * 0.25, bowlR * 0.08, bowlR * 0.035);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 210, 165, 0.20)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.1;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-bowlR * 0.085, -bowlR * 0.032);
    ctx.lineTo(bowlR * 0.085, -bowlR * 0.032);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();

    const sticks = compact
      ? [
          { x1: -bowlR * 0.62, y1: bowlR * 1.05, x2: bowlR * 1.12, y2: bowlR * 0.85, w1: 3.0, w2: 8.2 },
          { x1: -bowlR * 0.58, y1: bowlR * 1.13, x2: bowlR * 1.15, y2: bowlR * 0.95, w1: 3.0, w2: 8.2 },
        ]
      : [
          { x1: bowlR * 0.26, y1: bowlR * 0.88, x2: bowlR * 1.56, y2: bowlR * 0.36, w1: 3.2, w2: 8.6 },

        ];

    sticks.forEach((s, idx) => {
      const lift = idx === 0 ? -hoverShift * 0.4 : 0;
      const angle = Math.atan2(s.y2 - s.y1, s.x2 - s.x1);
      const len = Math.hypot(s.x2 - s.x1, s.y2 - s.y1);
      const sc = bowlR / 230;

      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(s.x1 + 5, s.y1 + 11);
      ctx.rotate(angle);
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.52)';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(0, -s.w1 * sc * 0.5);
      ctx.lineTo(len, -s.w2 * sc * 0.55);
      ctx.lineTo(len, s.w2 * sc * 0.55);
      ctx.lineTo(0, s.w1 * sc * 0.5);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.restore();

      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(s.x1, s.y1 + lift);
      ctx.rotate(angle);
      const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, -s.w2 * sc * 0.5, 0, s.w2 * sc * 0.5);
      grad.addColorStop(0, '#5a3d2b');
      grad.addColorStop(0.28, '#382217');
      grad.addColorStop(0.75, '#1d100a');
      grad.addColorStop(1, '#100805');

      ctx.fillStyle = grad;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(0, -s.w1 * sc * 0.5);
      ctx.lineTo(len, -s.w2 * sc * 0.5);
      ctx.lineTo(len, s.w2 * sc * 0.5);
      ctx.lineTo(0, s.w1 * sc * 0.5);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();

      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(196, 148, 78, 0.42)';
      ctx.fillRect(len * 0.78, -s.w2 * sc * 0.44, len * 0.022, s.w2 * sc * 0.88);
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(196, 148, 78, 0.25)';
      ctx.fillRect(len * 0.815, -s.w2 * sc * 0.45, len * 0.01, s.w2 * sc * 0.9);

      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 206, 152, 0.22)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.1;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(4, -s.w1 * sc * 0.26);
      ctx.lineTo(len - 4, -s.w2 * sc * 0.28);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.restore();
    });

    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawCeramicBowlExterior(lx, ly) {

    );

    );

      -bowlR * 0.34 + lx * bowlR * 0.38, bowlR * 0.16 + ly * bowlR * 0.22, bowlR * 0.08,

    );

  function drawRamenContents(t, lx, ly) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(cx, cy);

    const outerRx = bowlR * 1.03;
    const outerRy = bowlR * 1.03 * tiltY;
    const rimThickness = bowlR * 0.055;
    const innerRx = outerRx - rimThickness;
    const innerRy = outerRy - rimThickness * tiltY;

    const brothY = bowlR * 0.088;
    const brothRx = innerRx * 0.965;
    const brothRy = innerRy * 0.92;

    // 1. Nori sheets tucked cleanly into the back-right inner wall, rising naturally past the back rim
    drawNoriSheets(t, lx, ly, brothY, innerRx, innerRy);

    // 2. Back half of stoneware rim drawn BEHIND the nori sheets? No: nori is tucked inside the bowl,
    // so we draw the back rim lip first, then the nori rising out of the soup, then clip the soup inside innerRx/innerRy.
    // To keep the nori bottom naturally submerged in the broth, we clip the soup layer cleanly inside innerRx/innerRy!

    ctx.save();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, 0, innerRx, innerRy, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.clip();

    // Golden creamy vegan miso-sesame broth
    ctx.save();
    ellipsePath(0, brothY, brothRx, brothRy);
    ctx.clip();

    const simmer = reducedMotion ? 0 : Math.sin(t * 1.35) * 0.015;
    const brothGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
      -brothRx * 0.14 + lx * bowlR * 0.22,
      brothY - brothRy * 0.18 + ly * bowlR * 0.16,
      bowlR * 0.08,
      0, brothY, brothRx * 1.06
    );
    brothGrad.addColorStop(0, '#dd903a');
    brothGrad.addColorStop(0.32, '#bd6c22');
    brothGrad.addColorStop(0.68, '#8a4412');
    brothGrad.addColorStop(0.92, '#5c2809');
    brothGrad.addColorStop(1, '#3b1705');
    ctx.fillStyle = brothGrad;
    ctx.fillRect(-brothRx, brothY - brothRy, brothRx * 2, brothRy * 2);

    // Rich swirling miso & rayu clouding
    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
      const a = i * 1.08 + (reducedMotion ? 0 : t * 0.08 * (i % 2 === 0 ? 1 : -1));
      const sx = Math.cos(a) * brothRx * 0.36;
      const sy = brothY + Math.sin(a) * brothRy * 0.34;
      const sr = bowlR * (0.28 + (i % 3) * 0.08);
      const swGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(sx, sy, 0, sx, sy, sr);
      if (i % 2 === 0) {
        swGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(248, 182, 90, 0.18)');
        swGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(248, 182, 90, 0)');
      } else {
        swGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(182, 48, 12, 0.16)');
        swGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(182, 48, 12, 0)');
      }
      ctx.fillStyle = swGrad;
      ellipsePath(sx, sy, sr, sr * tiltY);
      ctx.fill();
    }

    // Subtle simmering convection rings
    if (!reducedMotion) {
      for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        const phase = (t * 0.24 + i * 0.33) % 1;
        const r = phase * brothRx * 0.88;
        const alpha = Math.sin(phase * Math.PI) * 0.07;
        ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255, 224, 160, ${alpha.toFixed(3)})`;
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.6;
        ellipsePath(Math.sin(t * 0.5 + i) * 6, brothY + Math.cos(t * 0.4 + i) * 3, r, r * tiltY * 0.94);
        ctx.stroke();
      }
    }

    // Submerged noodles
    drawNoodles(t, brothY, 0);

    // Translucent golden broth veil over submerged noodles
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(164, 86, 24, 0.28)';
    ellipsePath(0, brothY, brothRx, brothRy);
    ctx.fill();

    // Folded golden surface ramen noodle nest peeking richly in center-front
    drawNoodles(t, brothY, 1);

    // Floating chili oil & sesame oil pearls
    drawOilDroplets(t, brothY, lx, ly);

    // Interactive cursor ripples
    drawRipples();

    // Wet broth meniscus rim shadow & highlight
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(28, 10, 3, 0.56)';
    ctx.lineWidth = bowlR * 0.032;
    ellipsePath(0, brothY, brothRx * 0.995, brothRy * 0.995);
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255, 214, 150, ${(0.24 + simmer).toFixed(3)})`;
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.6;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, brothY, brothRx * 0.978, brothRy * 0.978, 0, -Math.PI * 0.85, -Math.PI * 0.15);
    ctx.stroke();

    // Soft dynamic broth surface specular reflection
    const sheenX = -brothRx * 0.24 + lx * bowlR * 0.26;
    const sheenY = brothY - brothRy * 0.22 + ly * bowlR * 0.18;
    const sheenGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(sheenX, sheenY, bowlR * 0.02, sheenX, sheenY, bowlR * 0.58);
    sheenGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 234, 188, 0.25)');
    sheenGrad.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255, 196, 120, 0.085)');
    sheenGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 196, 120, 0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = sheenGrad;
    ellipsePath(sheenX, sheenY, bowlR * 0.58, bowlR * 0.58 * tiltY);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.restore(); // end broth clip

    // Vegan gourmet toppings (back-to-front depth order)
    drawBokChoy(t, brothY, lx, ly);
    drawCornCluster(t, brothY);
    drawWoodEarMushrooms(t, brothY, lx, ly);
    drawSearedTofuSlices(t, brothY, lx, ly);
    drawShiitakeCaps(t, brothY, lx, ly);
    drawChiliThreads(t, brothY);
    drawScallions(t, brothY);
    drawSesameSeeds(t, brothY);

    // Subtle inner rim occlusion
    const frontRimShadow = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, innerRx * 0.72, 0, 0, innerRx * 1.02);
    frontRimShadow.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');
    frontRimShadow.addColorStop(0.84, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');
    frontRimShadow.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(10, 5, 3, 0.66)');
    ctx.fillStyle = frontRimShadow;
    ellipsePath(0, 0, innerRx, innerRy);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.restore(); // end inner bowl clip

    // Stoneware rim highlight — drawn around front & sides, smoothly passing behind the protruding nori
    drawBowlRimHighlight(outerRx, outerRy, innerRx, innerRy, lx, ly);

    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawNoriSheets(t, lx, ly, brothY, innerRx, innerRy) {
    // Two crisp toasted nori sheets nestled inside the upper-right rim, rising organically out of the bowl
    // We draw the back stoneware rim arc BEHIND them first so the nori visibly sits inside the bowl, not behind it!
    const outerRx = bowlR * 1.03;
    const outerRy = bowlR * 1.03 * tiltY;
    const midRx = (outerRx + innerRx) * 0.5;
    const midRy = (outerRy + innerRy) * 0.5;
    const rimW = outerRx - innerRx;

    // Back-right rim segment behind the nori
    ctx.save();
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#3a2a22';
    ctx.lineWidth = rimW * 0.96;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, 0, midRx, midRy, 0, -Math.PI * 0.45, -Math.PI * 0.04);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();

    const sheets = [
      { x: bowlR * 0.25, y: -bowlR * 0.50, rot: 0.14, w: bowlR * 0.44, h: bowlR * 0.50, sway: 0.012 },
      { x: bowlR * 0.50, y: -bowlR * 0.34, rot: 0.42, w: bowlR * 0.41, h: bowlR * 0.46, sway: 0.015 },
    ];

    sheets.forEach((sh, idx) => {
      const sway = reducedMotion ? 0 : Math.sin(t * 1.05 + idx * 1.7) * sh.sway + lx * 0.014;
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(sh.x, sh.y);
      ctx.rotate(sh.rot + sway);

      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(-sh.w * 0.48, sh.h * 0.46);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-sh.w * 0.52, -sh.h * 0.05, -sh.w * 0.45, -sh.h * 0.52);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(0, -sh.h * 0.57, sh.w * 0.46, -sh.h * 0.48);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(sh.w * 0.51, -sh.h * 0.02, sh.w * 0.44, sh.h * 0.48);
      ctx.closePath();

      ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55)';
      ctx.shadowBlur = 12;
      ctx.shadowOffsetX = -4;
      ctx.shadowOffsetY = 6;

      const nGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(-sh.w * 0.5, -sh.h * 0.5, sh.w * 0.5, sh.h * 0.5);
      nGrad.addColorStop(0, '#1e301c');
      nGrad.addColorStop(0.45, '#0e190f');
      nGrad.addColorStop(1, '#070d07');
      ctx.fillStyle = nGrad;
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.shadowColor = 'transparent';

      ctx.clip();
      if (noriCanvas) {
        const pat = ctx.createPattern(noriCanvas, 'repeat');
        ctx.globalAlpha = 0.72;
        ctx.fillStyle = pat;
        ctx.fillRect(-sh.w, -sh.h, sh.w * 2, sh.h * 2);
        ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      }

      // Warm amber backlight along top edge of nori
      const edgeLight = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, -sh.h * 0.57, 0, -sh.h * 0.14);
      edgeLight.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(148, 182, 104, 0.36)');
      edgeLight.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(148, 182, 104, 0)');
      ctx.fillStyle = edgeLight;
      ctx.fillRect(-sh.w * 0.6, -sh.h * 0.6, sh.w * 1.2, sh.h * 0.5);

      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(218, 240, 180, 0.22)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(-sh.w * 0.43, -sh.h * 0.50);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(0, -sh.h * 0.55, sh.w * 0.44, -sh.h * 0.46);
      ctx.stroke();

      ctx.restore();
    });
  }

  function drawNoodles(t, brothY, targetLayer) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.lineCap = 'round';
    ctx.lineJoin = 'round';

    for (let i = 0; i < noodleStrands.length; i++) {
      const n = noodleStrands[i];
      if (n.layer !== targetLayer) continue;

      if (targetLayer === 0) {
        const drift = reducedMotion ? 0 : Math.sin(t * 0.9 + n.phase) * 0.008;
        const steps = 16;
        ctx.beginPath();
        for (let s = 0; s <= steps; s++) {
          const u = s / steps;
          const ang = n.baseAngle + u * n.arcSpan;
          const wave = Math.sin(u * n.waveFreq * Math.PI + n.phase + (reducedMotion ? 0 : t * 0.5)) * n.waveAmp;
          const r = (n.rad + wave) * bowlR;
          const x = (n.offsetX + drift) * bowlR + Math.cos(ang) * r;
          const y = brothY + (n.offsetY + drift * 0.5) * bowlR * tiltY + Math.sin(ang) * r * tiltY;
          if (s === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y);
          else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
        }
        ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(218, 156, 70, ${(0.34 * n.shade).toFixed(3)})`;
        ctx.lineWidth = n.thickness * bowlR * 1.1;
        ctx.stroke();
      } else {
        // Cohesive folded golden noodle bundle arching gently through the center-front broth
        const steps = 22;
        const sway = reducedMotion ? 0 : Math.sin(t * 1.05 + n.phase) * 0.006;
        const spread = n.lane * 0.46;

        ctx.beginPath();
        for (let s = 0; s <= steps; s++) {
          const u = s / steps; // 0 (left-front) -> 1 (right-front)
          const tCurve = (u - 0.5) * 2; // -1..1
          const arch = (1 - tCurve * tCurve) * 0.24;
          const crinkle = Math.sin(u * n.waveFreq * Math.PI + n.phase + (reducedMotion ? 0 : t * 0.45)) * n.waveAmp;
          const nx = (-0.04 + tCurve * 0.42 + spread * 0.35 + sway) * bowlR;
          const ny = brothY + (0.36 - arch + spread * 0.48 + n.yShift + crinkle) * bowlR * tiltY;
          if (s === 0) ctx.moveTo(nx, ny);
          else ctx.lineTo(nx, ny);
        }

        const lw = n.thickness * bowlR;
        // Shadow
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(72, 30, 6, 0.48)';
        ctx.lineWidth = lw * 1.32;
        ctx.stroke();

        // Rich alkaline wheat noodle color
        const rCol = Math.min(255, Math.round(244 * n.shade));
        const gCol = Math.min(255, Math.round(202 * n.shade));
        const bCol = Math.min(255, Math.round(114 * n.shade));
        ctx.strokeStyle = `rgb(${rCol}, ${gCol}, ${bCol})`;
        ctx.lineWidth = lw;
        ctx.stroke();

        // Glossy wet broth highlight on top crest of noodle
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 248, 220, 0.48)';
        ctx.lineWidth = lw * 0.26;
        ctx.stroke();
      }
    }

    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawOilDroplets(t, brothY, lx, ly) {
    for (let i = 0; i < oilDroplets.length; i++) {
      const d = oilDroplets[i];
      const wobbleX = reducedMotion ? 0 : Math.cos(t * d.speed + d.phase) * d.driftR;
      const wobbleY = reducedMotion ? 0 : Math.sin(t * d.speed * 0.8 + d.phase) * d.driftR * tiltY;
      const x = (d.x + wobbleX) * bowlR;
      const y = brothY + (d.y + wobbleY) * bowlR;
      const r = d.r * bowlR;

      const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
        x - r * 0.25 + lx * r * 0.35, y - r * 0.25 + ly * r * 0.25, r * 0.1,
        x, y, r
      );
      if (d.isChili) {
        grad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 132, 42, 0.84)');
        grad.addColorStop(0.55, 'rgba(198, 48, 12, 0.74)');
        grad.addColorStop(0.88, 'rgba(128, 22, 6, 0.46)');
        grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(128, 22, 6, 0)');
      } else {
        grad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 236, 170, 0.60)');
        grad.addColorStop(0.6, 'rgba(224, 154, 56, 0.36)');
        grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(180, 108, 28, 0)');
      }
      ctx.fillStyle = grad;
      ellipsePath(x, y, r, r * tiltY * 1.04);
      ctx.fill();

      if (r > bowlR * 0.018) {
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 248, 224, 0.66)';
        ellipsePath(x - r * 0.32 + lx * r * 0.2, y - r * 0.25 * tiltY, r * 0.22, r * 0.14);
        ctx.fill();
      }
    }
  }

  function drawRipples() {
    for (let i = 0; i < ripples.length; i++) {
      const rp = ripples[i];
      ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255, 228, 174, ${rp.alpha.toFixed(3)})`;
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.4;
      ellipsePath(rp.x, rp.y, rp.r, rp.r * tiltY);
      ctx.stroke();

      ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(92, 38, 10, ${(rp.alpha * 0.5).toFixed(3)})`;
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.0;
      ellipsePath(rp.x, rp.y + 1.5, rp.r * 0.92, rp.r * 0.92 * tiltY);
      ctx.stroke();

  function updateSteam(dt, t) {
    if (reducedMotion) return;

    const windX = pointer.tx * 0.14 + Math.sin(t * 0.35) * 0.04;

    for (let i = 0; i < steamWisps.length; i++) {
      const w = steamWisps[i];
      w.age += dt;
      if (w.age >= w.life) {
        spawnSteamWisp(w, false);
        continue;
      }

      const progress = w.age / w.life;
      const nVal = noise2(w.x * 2.4 + t * 0.28, w.y * 2.0 - t * 0.32) - 0.5;
      const curl = Math.sin(w.age * w.curlFreq + w.phase) * w.curlAmp * 0.5 + nVal * 0.26;

      if (pointer.active) {
        const sx = cx + w.x * bowlR;
        const sy = cy + w.y * bowlR;
        const dx = sx - pointer.px;
        const dy = sy - pointer.py;
        const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
        const interactR = bowlR * 0.78;
        if (dist < interactR && dist > 1) {
          const force = Math.pow(1 - dist / interactR, 1.65);
          w.vx += (pointer.vx / bowlR) * force * dt * 1.2;
          w.vy += (pointer.vy / bowlR) * force * dt * 0.55;
          w.vx += (dx / dist) * force * dt * 0.7;
        }
      }

      w.vx += (windX + curl - w.vx) * Math.min(1, dt * 1.6);
      w.vy += (-(0.30 + progress * 0.18) - w.vy) * Math.min(1, dt * 1.1);

      w.x += w.vx * dt;
      w.y += w.vy * dt;
      w.rot += (w.vx * 0.6 + nVal * 0.3) * dt;
    }

    for (let i = ripples.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const rp = ripples[i];
      rp.r += rp.speed * dt;
      rp.alpha *= Math.pow(0.18, dt);
      if (rp.r >= rp.maxR || rp.alpha < 0.01) {
        ripples.splice(i, 1);
      }
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < motes.length; i++) {
      const m = motes[i];
      m.x += (m.vx + Math.sin(t * 0.6 + m.phase) * 0.004) * dt;
      m.y += m.vy * dt;
      if (m.y < -0.05) {
        m.y = 1.05;
        m.x = Math.random();
      }
      if (m.x < -0.05) m.x = 1.05;
      if (m.x > 1.05) m.x = -0.05;
    }
  }

    for (let i = 0; i < steamRibbons.length; i++) {
      const rb = steamRibbons[i];
      const timeVal = reducedMotion ? 1.8 : t * rb.speed;
      const segs = 20;
      const baseX = cx + rb.baseX * bowlR;
      const baseY = cy + (0.04 + rb.baseY * tiltY) * bowlR;
      const plumeH = rb.height * bowlR;

      const pts = [];
      for (let s = 0; s <= segs; s++) {
        const u = s / segs;
        const sway =
          Math.sin(u * 4.8 - timeVal + rb.phase) * rb.amp * bowlR * (0.18 + u * 1.18) +
          Math.cos(u * 2.5 - timeVal * 0.65 + rb.phase) * rb.amp * bowlR * 0.48 * u;
        let px = baseX + sway + lx * bowlR * 0.16 * u;
        let py = baseY - u * plumeH;

        if (pointer.active && !reducedMotion) {
          const dx = px - pointer.px;
          const dy = py - pointer.py;
          const d = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
          const rad = bowlR * 0.8;
          if (d < rad && d > 1) {
            const push = Math.pow(1 - d / rad, 2) * bowlR * 0.2 * u;
            px += (dx / d) * push;
          }
        }
        pts.push({ x: px, y: py, u });
      }

      // Soft outer misty halo along ribbon spine
      for (let s = 1; s < pts.length; s++) {
        const p1 = pts[s];
        const u = p1.u;
        const env = Math.sin(u * Math.PI) * Math.pow(1 - u, 0.4);
        const w = rb.width * bowlR * (0.55 + u * 1.85);
        const alpha = rb.alpha * env;
        if (alpha < 0.002) continue;

        const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(p1.x, p1.y, 0, p1.x, p1.y, w);
        g.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255, 242, 224, ${(alpha * 1.15).toFixed(4)})`);
        g.addColorStop(0.45, `rgba(238, 214, 188, ${(alpha * 0.45).toFixed(4)})`);
        g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(210, 180, 150, 0)');
        ctx.fillStyle = g;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(p1.x, p1.y, w, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
      }

      // Delicate silky core wisp curve for unmistakable photographic steam curls
      ctx.save();
      ctx.lineCap = 'round';
      for (let s = 1; s < pts.length - 1; s++) {
        const p0 = pts[s - 1];
        const p1 = pts[s];
        const u = p1.u;
        const env = Math.sin(u * Math.PI) * Math.pow(1 - u, 0.6);
        const coreAlpha = rb.alpha * 0.55 * env;
        if (coreAlpha < 0.002) continue;
        ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255, 246, 232, ${coreAlpha.toFixed(4)})`;
        ctx.lineWidth = rb.width * bowlR * (0.22 + u * 0.55);
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(p0.x, p0.y);
        ctx.lineTo(p1.x, p1.y);
        ctx.stroke();
      }
      ctx.restore();
    }

    // 2. Volumetric curling steam wisps
    for (let i = 0; i < steamWisps.length; i++) {
      const w = steamWisps[i];
      const p = w.age / w.life;
      const env = Math.pow(Math.sin(Math.min(1, p) * Math.PI), 1.12) * (1 - p * 0.35);
      const alpha = w.opacity * env;
      if (alpha < 0.002) continue;

      const x = cx + w.x * bowlR;
      const y = cy + w.y * bowlR;
      const radius = w.size * bowlR * (0.55 + p * 1.68);

      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(x, y);
      ctx.rotate(w.rot);
      ctx.scale(1, w.stretch);

      const rCol = Math.round(255 - p * 16);
      const gCol = Math.round(240 - p * 20);
      const bCol = Math.round(220 - p * 12);

      const sg = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, radius);
      sg.addColorStop(0, `rgba(${rCol}, ${gCol}, ${bCol}, ${alpha.toFixed(4)})`);
      sg.addColorStop(0.48, `rgba(${rCol - 14}, ${gCol - 18}, ${bCol - 16}, ${(alpha * 0.46).toFixed(4)})`);
      sg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(200, 175, 150, 0)');

      ctx.fillStyle = sg;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(0, 0, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.restore();
    }

    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawAmbientMotesAndVignette(t, lx, ly) {
    ctx.save();
    for (let i = 0; i < motes.length; i++) {
      const m = motes[i];
      const mx = m.x * width + lx * 18 * (0.4 + m.warmth);
      const my = m.y * height + ly * 12 * (0.4 + m.warmth);
      const distToBowl = Math.hypot(mx - cx, my - (cy - bowlR * 0.35));
      const warmBoost = Math.max(0.15, 1 - distToBowl / (bowlR * 2.8));
      const twinkle = reducedMotion ? 0.85 : (0.65 + 0.35 * Math.sin(t * 1.9 + m.phase));
      const a = m.alpha * warmBoost * twinkle;
      if (a < 0.015) continue;

      const mg = ctx.createRadialGradient(mx, my, 0, mx, my, m.r * 2.6);
      mg.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255, 214, 154, ${a.toFixed(3)})`);
      mg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 180, 100, 0)');
      ctx.fillStyle = mg;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(mx, my, m.r * 2.6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.restore();

    const vig = ctx.createRadialGradient(
      cx, cy - bowlR * 0.08, bowlR * 0.94,
      cx, cy, Math.max(width, height) * 0.78
    );
    vig.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');
    vig.addColorStop(0.62, 'rgba(5, 3, 2, 0.24)');
    vig.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(2, 1, 1, 0.84)');
    ctx.fillStyle = vig;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);

    if (grainPattern) {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'overlay';
      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.35;
      ctx.fillStyle = grainPattern;
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
      ctx.restore();
    }
  }

  function renderFrame(t, dt) {
    const ease = reducedMotion ? 1 : Math.min(1, dt * 4.5);
    const targetX = pointer.active ? pointer.nx : (reducedMotion ? 0 : Math.sin(t * 0.35) * 0.12);
    const targetY = pointer.active ? pointer.ny : (reducedMotion ? 0 : Math.cos(t * 0.27) * 0.08);
    pointer.tx += (targetX - pointer.tx) * ease;
    pointer.ty += (targetY - pointer.ty) * ease;
    pointer.vx *= Math.pow(0.05, dt);
    pointer.vy *= Math.pow(0.05, dt);

    const lx = reducedMotion ? 0 : pointer.tx;
    const ly = reducedMotion ? 0 : pointer.ty;

    updateSteam(dt, t);

    drawAtmosphereAndTable(t, lx, ly);
    drawGroundedShadows(lx, ly);
    drawChopsticks(t, lx, ly);
    drawCeramicBowlExterior(lx, ly);
    drawRamenContents(t, lx, ly);
    drawSteam(t, lx, ly);
    drawAmbientMotesAndVignette(t, lx, ly);
  }

  let lastTime = performance.now();
  function tick(now) {
    const dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - lastTime) / 1000);
    lastTime = now;

    if (!reducedMotion) {
      renderFrame(now * 0.001, dt);
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }

  buildProceduralTextures();
  resize();
  window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
  renderFrame(0, 0.016);
  requestAnimationFrame(tick);
})();
</script>

  - Toppings bob subtly in the simmering broth.
